intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — one targeted break check (requested by Story Wrap Up)

Invocation start: 2026-11-15T12:48:21Z (host clock; epoch ms 1794746907043 taken seconds later, before setup)
Story: .planning/seeds/SEED-359-claude-code-task-token-usage.md#view-claude-code-task-token-usage (plan .planning/slice-plans/636-claude-code-task-token-usage/PLAN.md)
Revision: d8bf8fb55e98b129e05d8c184e14eff083c76d30, scratch detached worktree /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/71bf9741/tmp/ic-scratch (npm ci, Node 24.21.0 per .node-version). Pre-probe state: clean.

Promise (Scope "Freshness" + Key example 3, validated against the seed): a Claude launch with a worker that finishes after the last check -> Refresh -> its point appears, including the worker's usage.
Fault (one, from the caller's suggestion, kept): Refresh's Claude reading step skips worker files under `<session>/subagents/`. Location: dashboard/server/usageRefresh.ts `claudeReading`, the loop `for (const file of changed)` changed to iterate `changed.filter(f => !f.includes("/subagents/"))`, with a scratch witness that appends each skipped path to a job-tmp file. Fixtures and assertions untouched. The offline import path (claudeUsage via the importer) was left intact, so only Refresh is faulted.
Not chosen: the checking-indication wording fault (one fault per check).
Command: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run test:dashboard:backend -- --reporter=list usage-history/token-index-refresh-claude
Maintained check examined: dashboard/backend-tests/usage-history/token-index-refresh-claude.spec.ts:76 "Refresh brings in a Claude launch finished since the last check with its worker, each response once, ..." (writes claude-2 root transcript plus worker `claude-2/subagents/agent-worker.jsonl`, refreshes over HTTP, asserts the Claude chart).

Baseline: 2 passed (12.8s runner), both tests in the spec, including :76.
Faulted: :76 failed at its first chart assertion (line 124 `expect(chart.tasks.map(...)).toEqual([...])`): expected ["SEED-7#claude-2","measured",4900], received ["SEED-7#claude-2","partial",1950]; the second test (:170, no worker) passed as expected. (A first faulted run also failed identically; its stderr witness was not surfaced by the runner, so the witness was moved to a file and the fault rerun.)
Independent wrong-behavior observation: the witness file recorded `skipped .../home/.claude/projects/open-dough/claude-2/subagents/agent-worker.jsonl` during the faulted run, i.e. the Refresh path reached and dropped exactly the worker transcript of the newly finished launch; the received chart value 1,950 = root only (1,450 + 5x100), missing the worker's 1,450 + 5x300, with coverage downgraded to partial — the promised "including the worker's usage" went wrong on the Refresh path.
Restore: fault reverted with git checkout; `git status --short` identical to pre-probe (clean), HEAD still d8bf8fb55; same command rerun: 2 passed (3.9s runner). Scratch worktree then removed with `git worktree remove --force` (not in `git worktree list`). The owner checkout was never edited.

Verdict: Caught. The maintained assertion at token-index-refresh-claude.spec.ts:124 (Claude chart tasks identity/coverage/index, expecting claude-2 measured 4,900) failed on independently observed wrong behavior. Claim limited to the observed path: Refresh over HTTP for a launch finishing after the last check whose worker lives under `<session>/subagents/`.
Next proof action: none required for this promise/fault; if more protection evidence is wanted, a separate check could target the other rewritten assertion (`showsChecking` "Checking for new usage…" in dashboard/tests/support/systemSettingsUsagePage.ts) with a wording-revert fault.
Prior disposition: none matched; no repair decision arises from this probe.

Cost:
- Test runtime: measured, Playwright runner totals — baseline 12.8s, faulted 4.3s and 4.0s (two faulted runs), unfaulted interim 3.8s, restored 3.9s; ~29s total runner time. Load average ~6-8 at baseline.
- Human effort: unavailable — no human interaction occurred or was measured in this run.
- Agent effort: unavailable as a separately supported measure — no token or agent-time counter was available to this agent; tool calls ~12 (count, estimated).

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 108040 ms (measured), from 1794746907043 to 1794747015083 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision d8bf8fb55e98b129e05d8c184e14eff083c76d30, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
